transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. AI. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess I'm here because... people are starting to notice that I can't just sit and listen. I just... I keep getting up when I'm supposed to stay put. Like during client interviews, or... tutoring sessions. Even at my book club. So... yeah. That's what brings me in.
Do you often interrupt people?

Um... I suppose I do. Yes. 

Like... if I overhear the junior detectives at work discussing a lead, or... even just a neighbor talking in the hallway. I'll just jump in. I start asking questions or giving advice before anyone actually asks me to. 

It's usually only later that I realize I... barged into a conversation that wasn't mine. So, yeah. I guess I do.
Have you ever gotten into physical fights because of acting on impulse?
No. Um... I don't get into physical fights. That's... not something I do.
Do you often feel restless or unable to stay seated when you’re expected to remain still?

Um... yes. I think I mentioned that earlier. 

I just... I can't seem to stay in my chair. Like I said, it happens during client interviews, or... when I'm tutoring. Even at my book club. I just... I get up. People have definitely noticed that I can't just sit there and listen. It's... yeah. It's a problem.
Do you also have trouble paying close attention when you’re supposed to, like missing details or losing track of what’s said?
Um... no, not really. I mean, I don't think so. I usually catch the details I need for my work. So... no.
Do you often make careless mistakes because you miss details?
No. Um... like I just said, I don't really miss details. So... no. I don't make careless mistakes.
Do you often lose things you need for work or daily activities, like keys, paperwork, or your phone?
Um... no. I don't think so. I usually know where my things are. I have to, for my job. So... no, I don't really lose things.
Do you often have trouble focusing on what people are saying to you?
Not really. I mean... listening to people is a big part of what I do all day. So, no, I hear them fine. It hasn't been an issue.
Do you often find it hard to finish tasks or follow through once the initial excitement wears off?
No... I finish things. I mean, my work requires me to follow through on cases, so... I do. I don't really have a problem with that.
Did these symptoms of restlessness and interrupting start before age 12?

I suppose. Um... if you look at my grade-school report cards, they always said I was bright, but... that I couldn't stay in my seat. Or wait my turn. My mother actually still jokes about it. She says I treated every classroom like a crime scene I had to pace through. So... yes. It was before twelve.
